description: This file implements a Google AI image generation service class that integrates with Google's Imagen models via the Google AI API. It provides methods for configuring image generation parameters, initializing the service with API credentials, and generating images asynchronously from text prompts, returning image frames or error frames.

classes.name: GoogleImageGenService
classes.description: A service class for generating images using Google's Imagen models via the Google AI API.

classes.name: GoogleImageGenService.InputParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for the image generation service, including number of images, model, and negative prompt.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the GoogleImageGenService with API key, optional parameters, and HTTP options.

methods.name: can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates that this service supports generating metrics.

methods.name: run_image_gen
methods.description: Asynchronously generates images from a text prompt, yielding image frames or error frames.
